Septum is a first-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and an android. She is one of the top students in the Night Owl class, which specializes in intelligence operations and sabotage.

Recently, after gaining the protagonist as a valuable test subjec..cooperative partner, she has been coming up with even more new gadgets.

Her abilities as a spy include hacking and the use of the gadgets she develops herself. Though quite eccentric, she has a good relationship with Septem, and the two appear just like a real parent and child.
